title: Sunny Health & Fitness Smart Mini Stepper (SF-S0978SMART)

comparisons.notes: Listing title includes model SF-S0978SMART; new, sold and shipped by Sunny Health & Fitness, in stock with next-day delivery.

writeup: Woot has the Sunny Health & Fitness Smart Mini Stepper (model SF-S0978SMART) for $29.99, while Walmart sells the same model for $89.99. It's a compact hydraulic stepper with resistance bands for upper-body work, an LCD monitor and Bluetooth tracking through the SunnyFit app. Woot showed only one left, with a limit of three per customer.
